_comment: Zero-shot prompts for the experimental CLIP attribute model. Each attribute compares a 'present' prompt set with an 'absent' prompt set. Age brackets are compared against each other. Do not add prompts for sensitive traits (race, ethnicity, religion, health, sexual orientation, etc.).

present: a face with clear prescription glasses
absent: a person not wearing any glasses

present: a face with dark sunglasses covering the eyes
a person wearing a face mask over the nose and mouth
a face covered by a medical mask
absent: a person with an uncovered mouth and nose

present: a face with a full beard
absent: a person with a clean-shaven face

present: a face with a mustache above the lip
absent: a face with a bare upper lip

3-9: a child under ten years old
10-19: a person between ten and nineteen years old
20-29: a young adult in their twenties
40-49: a middle-aged adult in their forties
60-69: an older adult in their sixties
70+: a person in their seventies or older
